description.zh:
检查项的ID。
> 您可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~116179~~)接口获取检查项ID。
description.en:
The ID of the check item.

> You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of check items.

description.zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 查询需要排除的服务器UUID。
description.en: The instance ID of the asset that you don't want to query.

description.zh: 指定要查询的服务器实例ID。
description.en: The instance ID of the asset.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

description.zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh: 要查询的资产信息，可以设置为资产名称、公网IP。
description.en: The information about the server that you want to query. The value can be the name or the public IP address of the server.

description.zh:
资源目录成员账号主账号ID。
>调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the IDs.

description.zh:
基线的ID。

> 您可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~116179~~)接口获取基线ID。
description.en:
The ID of the baseline.

> You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of baselines.

description.zh:
检查项风险状态。取值：
 - **1**：未通过
 - **3**：已通过
description.en:
The risk status of the check item. Valid values:

*   **1**: failed
*   **3**: passed

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-check-warning-machines --risk-id 43 --check-id 58 --status 1 --lang zh --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --remark 1.2.XX.XX --instance-id cri-rv4nvbv8iju40000 --filter-uuid 2f64e1a0f9316c480000000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
